connection.anm_or_curtailment_notes: MEC = MIC (import = export capacity), synthetic demo, issue 018

consents.notes: Full consents declared (synthetic demo, issue 018): G98/G99/G100 approved, export MPAN present.

export_arrangement.notes: Illustrative export arrangement (synthetic demo, Revenue-Data acceptance): aggregator cut 20%, illustrative export tariff £0.075/kWh and illustrative local-flex agreed rate £300/MWh. These are illustrative demo INPUTS a customer would supply, not underwritten market prices.

stream_consents.notes: Illustrative demo consent (Revenue-Data acceptance): customer authorises ancillary DC/DM/DR at an illustrative agreed £12,000/MW/yr. A commercially-agreed rate INPUT, not a market-cleared price; never bankable.

Illustrative demo consent (Revenue-Data acceptance): customer authorises Balancing Mechanism participation at an illustrative agreed £15,000/MW/yr. A commercially-agreed rate INPUT, not a market-cleared price; never bankable.

Illustrative demo consent (Revenue-Data acceptance): customer authorises the Capacity Market at an illustrative agreed £45/kW/yr. A commercially-agreed rate INPUT, not a market-cleared clearing price; deliverability physics still hold CM out of the priced floor (CONDITIONAL).
Illustrative demo consent (Revenue-Data acceptance): customer authorises DUoS red-band avoidance. Load-derived firm-floor stream — no agreed rate needed; consent is authorisation, not value.
Illustrative demo consent (Revenue-Data acceptance): customer authorises the load-service / firming stream. Priced from declared provisioning requirements only — no agreed rate here.

Illustrative demo consent (Revenue-Data acceptance): customer authorises local flexibility / Piclo. Its agreed rate lives on ExportArrangement.local_flex_agreed_rate_gbp_per_mwh (£300/MWh, illustrative), netted by the aggregator cut.

Illustrative demo consent (Revenue-Data acceptance): customer authorises MIC/ASC headroom use. £0 by construction (its value is realised through connection-bounded arbitrage) — consent is authorisation, not value.

Illustrative demo consent (Revenue-Data acceptance): customer authorises the PPA / bill-savings stream. Aggregate £0 in the value stack (itemised across tariff arbitrage + DUoS); the PPA £/kWh is set by the finance pricing layer.
Illustrative demo consent (Revenue-Data acceptance): customer authorises tariff arbitrage. Load-derived firm-floor stream — no agreed rate needed; consent is authorisation, not value.

Illustrative demo consent (Revenue-Data acceptance): customer authorises wholesale / P415 export. Its agreed rate lives on ExportArrangement.export_tariff_gbp_per_kwh (£0.075/kWh, illustrative) — agreed tariff × overlay export MWh is a CONTRACTED floor value; the Elexon-MID perfect-foresight delta stays separate indicative gated upside, never contracted.

source_references: SYNTHETIC — illustrative demo dataset, not a real site
